A candidate is a starting point.

RxNorm primarily covers US medicines. A lexical match is not a confidence percentage, proof of a local authorization, manufacturer, clinical equivalence or suitability for substitution. Normalized searches may ignore salt forms. Confirm only the identification level supported by the evidence. This tool is not WHODrug or automatic safety-case coding.

Results show up to six initial concepts and six related products for one brand family. More products may exist. API responses are cached in memory for up to 12 hours; reload for fresh retrieval. Saved decisions retain their captured source release and do not update automatically.
